statement:
{V} [AddCommGroup V] [LinearAlgebraGame.VectorSpace ℂ V] [LinearAlgebraGame.InnerProductSpace_v V] (v : V) :
  ⟪v,v⟫ = 0 ↔ v = 0
name: LinearAlgebraGame.inner_self_eq_zero
content:
For any vector `v`, `⟪v, v⟫ = 0` if and only if `v` is the zero vector.

**Usage:** Use the full name `LinearAlgebraGame.inner_self_eq_zero` when applying this theorem.
